notes.title: MILESTONE REACHED ($29.99 -> $26.99) | An update on our social experiment!
notes.notes:
Hey friends,  

How's it going? 
Here's a little update on our social experiment: 
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2719740/view/524227425953908791"][/dynamiclink]
We're making good progress - our initial milestones however might've been a little bit too optimistic, so we lowered the numbers.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779790/da73b36ff3b7b5ec1c32d20ebd32dc318da86c24.png"]
And with that, we've already reached our 1st milestone, so our launch price dropped to $26.99!
Can we go even lower? 35K would be a dream come true!

 
[hr][/hr]

Here’s how you can contribute:[olist]
Wishlist Zero Caliber 2 Remastered on Steam (step 1):


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2719740/Zero_Caliber_2_Remastered/"][/dynamiclink]

Tell at least 1 friend about our mission (step 2)

Join our Discord (optional) -> https://discord.gg/xrealgames

[/olist][hr][/hr]

 If you've already wishlisted the game, don't forget to drop in here to enter our giveaway as well: 
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2719740/view/524226158154219957"][/dynamiclink]

BIG thanks for helping us push through the Steam algorithm and keep the co-op VR shooter genre alive!  

Cheers, 
Dan + the XREAL Games Team
